import java.util.*;
public class Solution
{
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        int l = s.length();
        int c = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < l; ) {
            int j = i;
            // Find the end of the current maximal sequence of identical nucleotides
            while (j < l - 1 && s.charAt(j) == s.charAt(j + 1)) {
                j++;
            }
            // Length of the current sequence
            int seqLength = j - i + 1;
            
            // If the sequence length is even, we need to insert seqLength/2 nucleotides
            // to break it into odd-length sequences
            if (seqLength % 2 == 0) {
                c += seqLength / 2;
            }
            
            // Move to the next sequence
            i = j + 1;
        }
        
        System.out.println(c);
        sc.close();
    }
}
